events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese, co-founder of Monty Python and star of Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Cleese Comedy King
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us some of the most iconic comedy moments in British history. What's your favourite Cleese classic?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Wonder
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unleashed the 'White Album' on the world. A sprawling masterpiece that changed everything. Which track is on repeat for you today?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Forever Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 today. His voice, his stage presence, his legacy – truly one of a kind.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Revolution
angles.copy: It's been 61 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that saw them push boundaries and evolve their sound. Still sounds incredible.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day, we remember music icon John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon today, a visionary artist who would have been 86. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Celebrating the birth of the legendary David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today.

angles.name: Bowie's Star
angles.copy: The Starman would have been 80 today. David Bowie, an artist who constantly reinvented himself and left an indelible mark on music, fashion, and culture. Forever missed.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering the birth of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have been 92 today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: The King would have been 92 today! Elvis Presley's influence is still felt across music and culture. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitar legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God Page
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page! The Led Zeppelin maestro whose riffs defined a generation. What's your ultimate Page guitar moment?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The distinctive voice of Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Rod The Mod Turns 82
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the legendary Rod Stewart! An enduring voice in rock and roll for decades. What's your go-to Rod hit?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson) celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Madness Main Man
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the one and only Suggs from Madness! The voice behind some truly iconic British anthems. What's your favourite nutty sound?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for his 80s hits, celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Young At Heart
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to the blue-eyed soul sensation Paul Young! Still 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' is a classic. What's your favourite Paul Young track?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The iconic country music legend Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday.

angles.name: Dolly's Diamond Day
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true queen of country, pop, and everything in between. What's your favourite Dolly moment?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Barlow's Big Day
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! From boyband heartthrob to songwriting legend, he's done it all. What's your favourite Gary-penned hit?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his 80s soul hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Ocean's 77
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the smooth voice of Billy Ocean! Still 'Caribbean Queen' in our hearts. What's your favourite Billy Ocean classic?

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame first induction
events.blurb: The first-ever induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame was held on this day in 1989.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: On this day in 1989, the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame held its very first induction ceremony. Who do you think was in that inaugural class? And who's still missing?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Owen's Day
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! From the early days to stadium tours, he's always been a pop favourite. What's your favourite Mark moment?

events.title: The Beatles' rooftop concert anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their famous impromptu rooftop concert on the Apple Corps building in London on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Rooftop Rockers
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles played their legendary rooftop concert. An iconic moment in music history that literally stopped London traffic. Imagine being there!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Grammy-winning musician, singer, and songwriter Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Collins' Classic Hits
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! A drumming maestro and hit-making vocalist. What's your favourite Phil Collins solo or Genesis track?

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Hugh Grant, known for his charming roles, celebrates his 67th birthday.

angles.name: Grant's Charms
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the ever-charming Hugh Grant! From rom-coms to more recent darker roles, he's a true British screen icon. What's your favourite Hugh Grant film?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar, singer, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: JT's Big Day
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From *NSYNC to solo hits and Hollywood, he's still bringing the 'SexyBack'. What's your favourite JT track?

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: National treasure Sir David Jason, star of Only Fools and Horses and A Touch of Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly Jason
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary Sir David Jason! A true British icon who has given us so many unforgettable characters. What's your favourite Del Boy moment?

events.title: The Day The Music Died anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died', when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash in 1959.

angles.name: Music's Tragic Day
angles.copy: Remembering 'The Day The Music Died'. 68 years ago today, we lost Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper in a tragic plane crash. Their music lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Rick Astley, known for his 80s pop hits and viral fame, celebrates his 61st birthday.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to the one and only Rick Astley! From 80s chart-topper to internet sensation, he's still got it. What's your favourite Rick hit?

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Celebrating the birth of reggae icon Bob Marley, who would have been 82 today.

angles.name: Marley's Message
angles.copy: The legendary Bob Marley would have been 82 today. His music and message of peace and unity continue to resonate globally. One love.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter Carole King, one of the most successful female artists in music history, celebrates her 85th birthday.

angles.name: Tapestry of Hits
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King! A songwriting genius and a voice that defined a generation. What's your favourite Carole King song?

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of the iconic vocalist Whitney Houston, who would have been 64.

angles.name: The Voice Remembered
angles.copy: Remembering the unforgettable Whitney Houston today, who would have been 64. Her voice was simply unmatched, a true legend.
